review_candidates.title: Field System Engineer - North Central Florida
review_candidates.description: Position Summary The Field Systems Engineer (FSE) is responsible for attending to service needs of bioMerieux customers within their assigned geographic territory, as well as nationally, on an as-needed basis, utilizing appropriate tools and test equipment. The FSE is a self-starter, with the ability to deliver a best-in-class customer experience, while working remotely without direct supervision and able to conduct overnight travel on short-notice. Position Duties Customer Service & Technical Execution: Promptly respond to customer needs and perform installations, maintenance, upgrades, and repairs using electronic and computer skills to ensure instruments meet specifications. Relationship Building & Sales Support: Build trust with customers, promote service agreements, and identify sales opportunities for cross-functional teams. Collaboration & Revenue Generation: Foster teamwork across service and support teams while driving field service revenue through billable offerings like preventive maintenance and equipment moves. Training Travel: Attend 6–9 weeks of product training at Durham, NC or St. Louis, MO offices within the first year; future trainings occur as needed. Customer Visit Travel: Travel includes both scheduled and unscheduled visits, with increased overnight stays for wide territories and occasional national travel. On-Call Support: Participate in weekend/holiday on-call rotation (~every 5 weeks), requiring local phone availability and potential national travel for instrument support. Documentation & Compliance: Timely and accurate completion of service work orders, QA checklists, and internal training requirements. Scheduling & Reporting: Maintain an up-to-date calendar of availability and submit travel expense reports regularly to avoid penalties. Fleet Management: Follow all company policies related to the use and upkeep of the assigned fleet vehicle. Asset & Inventory Management: Maintain spare parts inventory, company-issued vehicle, and all assigned equipment (e.g., laptop, tools, test devices) in good condition and per policy. Professional Development & Collaboration: Continuously improve technical and interpersonal skills, meet annual priorities, and collaborate with sales and applications teams to enhance customer experience. Strategic & Promotional Support: Represent bioMerieux professionally, support trade shows as needed, and provide feedback to Sales, Marketing, and Customer Service to help expand service capabilities. Perform all work in compliance with company quality procedures and standards. Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications Required Education, Training and Experience Bachelor degree required. 2+ years of professional related experience in troubleshooting and/or repair of complex electro-mechanical, electronic, computer, electrical systems in commercial, industrial, or military setting required. Education Substitution: In lieu of a Bachelor's degree, 6+ years of relevant experience, defined above, is required. Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license in state of residence. Preferred Education, Training and Experience Experience in troubleshooting and/or repair of biomedical, vacuum systems, host/remote communications and network systems, or similar systems and in a clinical laboratory setting preferred. Experience operating independently including managing schedules, customer expectations, and communications both internally and externally; prioritizing tasks; and resolving technical issues without direct oversight preferred. Experience in a field service role preferred. Experience in the principles and practices of laboratory operations preferred. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Consistently upholds and reflects the core ethical principles and values that bioMérieux promotes. Functional skills including critical thinking, adaptability, time management, communication, problem-solving and digital literacy. Detail orientation to complete tasks without errors and produce high-quality work. Thriving in a fast-paced environment by managing tasks, multitasking, and adapting quickly to maintain productivity. Organizing work and resources efficiently to ensure smooth operations Troubleshooting issues to identify and resolve problems efficiently Demonstrates assertiveness and confidence in the face of a challenge Effective verbal, written and presentation skills. Ability to work cross-functionally allowing for better collaboration and communication when working across teams to achieve shared objectives Intermediate skill in MS Office tools to include but not limited to Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel Working Conditions and Travel Physical requirements include: remaining in a stationary position for long periods, stair/ladder climbing, wearing PPE, operating heavy machinery, and lifting/moving up to 50 lbs. Travel requirement: Typical weekday travel is defined as daily customer visits not requiring overnight travel but expect daily driving of 50% or more. Weekend and Holiday rotational coverage is scheduled with the expectation of additional driving or flying within and/or outside of the standard assigned service region. Standard field service operations for customer support consists of approximately 15% of annual On-call with the expectation of overnight travel when qualified on products. Domestic travel: required up to 90% of the time Typical Regional travel (non-overnight): 50% Monday through Friday Weekend/Holiday rotational travel: up to 15% of the time The estimated wage range for this field based role in Florida is between $32.90 and $45.00 per hour. This role is eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and individual performance per bioMerieux’s bonus program. This range may differ from ranges offered for similar positions elsewhere in the country given differences in cost of living. Actual compensation within this range is determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and will be presented in writing at the time of the offer. In addition, bioMérieux offers a competitive Total Rewards package that may include: A choice of medical (including prescription), dental, and vision plans providing nationwide coverage and telemedicine options Company-Provided Life and Accidental Death Insurance Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance Retirement Plan including a generous non-discretionary employer contribution and employer match. Adoption Assistance Wellness Programs Employee Assistance Program Commuter Benefits Various voluntary benefit offerings Discount programs Parental leaves #biojobs

KVF TECH focuses on using cloud computing and AI to help clients drive growth, improve efficiency, and optimize operations. Team members work with modern cloud technologies and best practices to deliver reliable, scalable solutions in complex, regulated environments. Role Description This is a remote contract role for an AWS Cloud Engineer. The AWS Cloud Engineer will design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS, including networking, security, compute, storage, and monitoring components. Day-to-day responsibilities include building and deploying infrastructure as code, supporting application teams with environment provisioning, troubleshooting performance and reliability issues, and optimizing cloud resources for cost and scalability. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate applications with databases and other services, implementing best practices for security and compliance, and contributing to documentation and automation across the cloud environment. Candidates should possess Infrastructure skills, including designing and managing networks, security groups, load balancers, monitoring, and high-availability architectures. Candidates should possess Databases skills, including deploying, configuring, and optimizing relational or NoSQL databases in cloud environments. Strong problem-solving abilities, clear written and verbal communication, and the capacity to work independently in a remote, collaborative environment are essential. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is preferred; cloud certifications (such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus.

review_candidates.title: POS & IT Field Technician
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a technically skilled POS & IT Field Technician to provide on-site installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of NFC-enabled digital receipt devices integrated with merchants' existing POS systems. The successful candidate will work on a flexible, on-demand basis, visiting restaurants, retail stores, and other commercial establishments when installations or technical assistance are required. The technician will work closely with HTB's Remote IT & Customer Support Executive , who will manage incoming technical enquiries, provide initial remote troubleshooting, coordinate installation appointments, and arrange on-site assistance when necessary. The role requires someone who can work independently during site visits while maintaining clear communication with the remote support team. This is a contract-based opportunity, with compensation agreed per installation or service visit rather than a fixed monthly salary. Key ResponsibilitiesInstallation & Configuration Install, configure, and test NFC-enabled digital receipt devices at merchant locations. Configure connectivity between digital receipt devices and merchants' existing POS systems. Troubleshoot TCP/IP, LAN, Wi-Fi, DHCP, and network printer connections. Assist with thermal receipt printer configuration, including network settings and printer communication protocols. Support compatible POS and receipt-printing integrations, including TCP/IP Port 9100 where applicable. Conduct functional testing to confirm digital receipts are generated and accessible correctly. Verify that existing POS, payment, and receipt-printing operations remain unaffected. Technical Support & Troubleshooting Attend merchant locations to diagnose and resolve technical issues requiring physical intervention. Troubleshoot POS hardware, receipt printers, network connectivity, and related peripherals. Perform equipment configuration adjustments, replacements, and basic maintenance when required. Assist the remote IT support team with issues that cannot be resolved remotely. Escalate complex technical problems to HTB management or the relevant technology provider. Ensure installations and troubleshooting activities are completed professionally and efficiently. Coordination with Remote IT & Customer Support Executive Work closely with HTB's Remote IT & Customer Support Executive to coordinate installations, maintenance, and technical support visits. Receive and respond to assigned technical support requests requiring on-site assistance. Provide timely updates on appointment schedules, technical findings, and completed tasks. Collaborate with the remote support team to diagnose and resolve POS connectivity and device configuration issues. Document technical problems, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions for future reference. Notify the remote support team of unresolved issues requiring escalation. Maintain clear communication to ensure a smooth and consistent customer support experience. Merchant Onboarding & Field Operations Assist with the technical onboarding of new merchants. Provide basic operational training to merchant employees. Coordinate site access and installation requirements with merchant representatives. Maintain professional communication with restaurant managers, retail staff, and technical teams. Document completed installations and service visits. Submit brief installation and service reports to HTB's remote support team. Represent HTB professionally during all on-site assignments. Requirements Minimum 1–3 years of relevant experience in POS systems, IT field support, or technical installations. Strong practical knowledge of POS terminals and thermal receipt printers. Good understanding of TCP/IP networking, LAN, Wi-Fi, DHCP, and network configuration. Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, and device connectivity issues. Ability to independently diagnose and resolve technical problems on-site. Strong communication, organisational, and customer service skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with remote technical support personnel. Arabic communication skills required; English proficiency is an advantage. Reliable transportation and ability to travel between merchant locations across Jeddah. Flexible availability for scheduled installations and occasional technical support visits. Legal authorisation to provide the contracted services in Saudi Arabia. Preferred Qualifications Experience with POS platforms such as Foodics, Oracle MICROS, Aloha, or similar systems. Familiarity with Epson, Bixolon, and other thermal receipt printer brands. Experience configuring network printers, including TCP/IP printing and Port 9100. Previous experience supporting restaurants, retail stores, or payment technology providers. Diploma or relevant certification in Information Technology, Computer Networking, or a related field. Previous experience working with remote IT support teams or ticketing systems. What We Offer Flexible, contract-based assignments. Compensation per installation or service visit, agreed in advance. Product-specific technical training and installation guidance. Opportunity to work with innovative digital receipt technology. Ongoing assignments as HTB expands its merchant network. Potential for a long-term professional relationship based on performance and operational requirements. How to Apply Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications to: Email: info@htbanaja.com Email Subject: Applying for POS & IT Field Technician Please attach an updated CV highlighting your experience with POS systems, receipt printers, networking, and on-site technical support. Applicants are also encouraged to mention their availability in Jeddah and any relevant previous installation experience. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an online interview and may be invited to complete a practical technical assessment. HTB — Global Partnerships. Local Expertise.
